summary_1line: Agastya explains to Rama the primordial origin of Rakshasas and Yakshas, tracing the Rakshasa lineage from Prajapati through Heti, Bhaya, and their descendants.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shiva and Parvati riding the bull Nandi pause in the sky as they hear an abandoned infant crying on Mandara Mountain.
The terrified Rakshasi mother leaves her newborn on Mandara Mountain while clouds gather around the lonely crying child.
Prajapati addresses the hungry newly created beings, who declare 'Rakshami' and 'Yakshami' beneath the cosmic waters.
